name: Non Trading Day Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the reason capturing a non trading day.

THOL.name: Trading Holiday
THOL.definition: The date is a full day trading holiday with no trades performed.

OTHR.name: Other
OTHR.definition: Other reasons a day is a non-trading day e.g. technical fault, company specific non-trading day not known in advance.

HALF.name: Half Day
HALF.definition: Trading venue was open for an amount of time, up to half the day.

WKND.name: Weekend
WKND.definition: Date being reported falls during the weekend.
